title: Bispectrality and the ad conditions
summary: At the beginning of the study of the bispectral problem, see [18], the ad-conditions played a crucial role in finding non-classical instances. The connection with the ad-conditions has reappeared in several different incarnations of the bispectral problem. Here we show that, properly adapted versions of these conditions, see [44], can play an important role in areas including, for instance, the study of exceptional orthogonal polynomials.
